methodology.evidence: Directly confirmed restaurant visits only; do not promote interview leads automatically.
methodology.date: Exact visit date remains null unless verified. An assigned year is approximate, and a range is retained as a range.
methodology.awards: Awards link to their actual recipient and their actual year; later recognition does not imply historical status at time of meal.
methodology.map: Map groups experiences at approximate city centers, not exact venue entrances.
methodology.favorites: Favorites come only from explicit user preference statements, independent of restaurant awards.
methodology.musicAndDining: Attending a restaurant with live jazz does not automatically count as a distinct concert. Require a separately confirmed performance before adding a concert record.
methodology.awardFocusedCollection: Default Culture Passport Dining chapter shows only venues with verified historical Michelin inclusion or James Beard recognition of restaurant itself or chef at that restaurant. Memory-only confirmed visits are preserved but hidden by default, discoverable with a separate toggle. Recognition year may differ from dinner year.
